Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate position at RGU?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate position at Rajiv Gandhi University is 17th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc in Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for the Project Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate position at RGU will be based on a Walk-in-Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 31,000/- pm plus HRA@9% for CSIR-NET or GATE qualified candidates, and Rs. 25,000/- pm plus HRA@9% for others.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Associate-I position at Rajiv Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Rajiv Gandhi University located?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi University is located in Doimukh, Arunachal Pradesh, with the pincode 791112.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Project Associate recruitment at RGU is RGU/PC/DBT-NER/HR-686/2026.
